Subject: Vendr profile maintenance: proposed publish window & CAIQ snapshot

Hi Sandra —

We need to publish a small maintenance update to our Vendr security profile this week: a CAIQ delta (minor answers updated), the latest SOC 2 artifact pointer, and a short security scan summary. Goal is to keep the portal in-sync with our public profile before renewal conversations next month.

Proposed publish window: Wed 14 Jul, 09:00–10:00 PT (we'll upload via presigned links). Ask: can you open a presign upload window for that slot (TTL >= 4 hours) and confirm any max object size limits?

Files we'll push (attached as stubs in this thread):
- redwood-caiq-delta-202707.zip (CAIQ delta + change log)
- security-scan-summary-20270712.pdf (Snyk/Trivy high-level)
- manifest.csv (list of file hashes and paths)

Operational asks:
1) Vendr: grant temporary uploader role to the portal uploader account for the TTL window; share the presign endpoint and any required headers.
2) Redwood Security: verify uploaded artifacts (hashes) and confirm CAIQ mapping after publish.
3) CS/Sales: I'll update HubSpot with the mutual action plan and link to the profile update so Renewals have the latest view.

If Wed morning is rough, alternate windows: Tue 13 Jul 15:00–16:00 PT or Thu 15 Jul 08:00–09:00 PT.

Thanks — want to get this low-friction and documented so we don't generate extra redlines in the renewal cycle.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-caiq-delta-202707.zip (application/zip), security-scan-summary-20270712.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks Ben — happy to help. Wed 14 Jul 09:00–10:00 PT works for us. A few clarifying items from the portal side: 

• Presign window: we can issue presign tokens with a TTL up to 8 hours. For large bundles we recommend splitting into 250MB chunks.
• Max object size: 1GB per object.
• Upload account: please use the temporary uploader account vendr-upload@vendr.co (we'll map to the profile as the actor for auditing).

Can you also include a short README.txt inside the zip describing which CAIQ sections changed? Our onboarding team uses that to surface changes to reviewers. If you prefer, we can create the presign links and drop them into a secure message on the portal (I can place them in the profile under the 'Pending Uploads' tab).

I've attached a short note on our presign guidance and the recommended manifest format — vendr-presign-guidance.pdf.

Sandra
Sandra Lopez
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Vendr

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sandra. We'll do Wed 14 Jul 09:00–10:00 PT. Action items on my side:

- I'll drop the presign upload request in the portal 'Pending Uploads' at 08:45 PT on Wed so tokens are available.
- We'll include README.txt in the zip that points out CAIQ delta sections (security, encryption, logging).
- Security will run quick hash verification and post a verification note in the profile comments thread after upload.
- I'll push a mutual action plan into HubSpot and link it here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-7890

One small note about the scan summary: it's a high-level export (no vuln PII or stack traces). If Vendr requires more, let us know and Security can prepare an internal redacted artifact.

Ben
